name: National Bureau of Statistics
description: Federal statistical agency. Publishes CPI, GDP, employment, household consumption and poverty surveys.

name: Central Bank of Nigeria
description: Monetary authority. Publishes the Monetary Policy Rate, FX rates, external reserves, money supply and balance of payments.

name: Debt Management Office
description: Manages Nigeria's public debt and publishes the quarterly debt bulletin.

name: Budget Office of the Federation
description: Prepares and publishes the federal budget — proposed, approved and executed.

name: Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission
description: Regulates upstream petroleum operations and publishes monthly crude oil production by terminal.

name: Nigerian Exchange Group
description: Nigeria's primary equities market. Publishes the All-Share Index and sector indices.
